entities.name: Xenopus mitochondrial MARS2
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q7T0Z0, annotated as mitochondrial methionine--tRNA ligase; EC 6.1.1.10.
Reference reaction: tRNA(Met) + L-methionine + ATP = L-methionyl-tRNA(Met) + AMP + diphosphate (Rhea RHEA:13481).
Reference localization: mitochondrial matrix. Query sequence is 562 aa; Pfam matches include tRNA-synt_1g and Anticodon_3.
